name: Central Puebla Nahuatl
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Lastra, Yolanda. 1990. El náhuatl del sur de Puebla. Anales de Antropología 27(1): 383-390. UNAM-IIA. (Glottolog ref 318822)
sources.note: Nothing. Read all 8 pages (pp. 384-386, 388-389 visually; rest via text layer). The phonological remarks cover /i/ for /e/, final -n, epenthetic /y/, vowel length in 'amargo', fricative realisation of /y/ in Xochiltepec; no mention of acento/stress at all. fetched sources via the Wayback Machine because revistas.unam.mx is Cloudflare-blocked from our machine.
